task: A cafe buys 3 packs of tea at Rs 285 per pack, plus one Rs 99 sample. What is the total in rupees? Give the number.
Write a Python function slugify(s) that lowercases s, replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strips leading/trailing hyphens. Output only the code.
Price formula: take the INR price, multiply by 2.5, then divide by 96. What is the USD price of a Rs 285 item? Round to 2 decimals and give just the number.

Extract every lot code from this text and return ONLY a JSON array of strings in order of appearance: 'Shipped EX-118 and CB-204 yesterday; DO-2026-BK-070 is next, then BL-2026-CT-311. Ref INV-2231 is an invoice, not a lot.'

Write a Python function parse_lot(code) for lot codes like 'DO-2026-BK-070' (region, year, type, number) and short codes like 'EX-118' (region, number). Return a dict with keys region, year, type, num; year and type are None for short codes; year and num are ints. Output only the code.
Reply with exactly three bullet points (each starting with '- ') on how to write a clearer email. Nothing else.
Return only a JSON object with keys "city" and "country" for the Eiffel Tower. No other text.
Write a tagline for a neighbourhood bakery in exactly 8 words. Output only the tagline.
Write an Instagram caption for a handmade soap called Cedar Morning: exactly 3 lines of text, then one final line with exactly 6 hashtags. No emojis. Mention batch code CM-12.
Write one sentence for our website stating the lab-tested purity percentage and the average customer rating of our Cedar Morning soap.
Write a two-sentence product description for a stainless steel water bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours.

checks.pattern: \b(unlock|elevate|seamless(ly)?|game[- ]changer|say goodbye|reimagined|take it to the next level)\b

task: This Python function raises ZeroDivisionError for an empty list: def avg(xs): return sum(xs)/len(xs). Fix it so avg([]) returns 0. Output only the code.
Improve this agent instruction so it gives better results, and output only the improved instruction: 'Write good emails to customers.'
